summary_en: 1,918,784 shares to be cancelled (6.68% of shares outstanding). Effective 2026-09-15. Post-cancellation shares outstanding: 26,808,464. Contingent on approval of stock consolidation at 2026-08-24 extraordinary shareholders meeting.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-24, Nippon Dry-Chemical's board resolved to cancel 1,918,784 treasury shares under Companies Act Article 178. The shares represent 6.68% of shares outstanding (calculated as 1,918,784 ÷ 28,727,248 excluding treasury). Cancellation is scheduled to take effect 2026-09-15 and is conditional on shareholder approval of a concurrent stock consolidation at the extraordinary shareholders meeting scheduled for 2026-08-24. The cancellation amount comprises 1,912,544 shares currently held in treasury as of 2026-07-07, plus 6,240 restricted shares to be acquired for free by two directors. Post-cancellation shares outstanding will total 26,808,464.
